title: Don't Pass@k: A Bayesian Framework for Large Language Model Evaluation
authors_zh: Mohsen Hariri、Amirhossein Samandar、Michael Hinczewski、Vipin Chaudhary（凯斯西储大学）
paper_type_zh: 贝叶斯评测方法与采样预算分析（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 需要解释推理模型评分差异、重复采样预算和分级评分结果的研究者。
one_line: Bayes@N estimates performance and sampling uncertainty from repeated correctness or rubric outcomes using a Dirichlet model.
Bayes@N 用 Dirichlet 模型，根据多次试验的正确性或评分分类结果估计性能及其采样不确定性。
why: Reasoning-data and sampling-budget comparisons need to distinguish measured score differences from finite-trial uncertainty.
inclusion_reason: It makes the trial budget and uncertainty explicit when interpreting reasoning-model evaluation and sampling-based comparisons.

title: Problem
问题
html: Repeated-sampling scores can change model order when only a few trials are available. A scalar Pass@k score also leaves open how much evidence supports a comparison. This matters when reasoning evaluations are expensive and benchmark questions are few. The paper asks how to estimate performance and its uncertainty from the outcomes already collected, including graded rubric categories.
可用试验次数较少时，重复采样评分可能改变模型排序，单个 Pass@k 数值也没有说明比较背后有多少证据。推理评测通常成本较高，题目数量也有限。论文关注的是如何利用已收集的结果估计性能及其不确定性，并把分级评分纳入同一计算。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Each question has an unknown probability vector over outcome categories. A Dirichlet prior and the observed category counts give a posterior distribution. Rubric weights define the quantity being estimated: average expected weighted score across the benchmark questions. Bayes@N reports its posterior mean and standard deviation. Under a uniform prior and equal trial counts, the posterior-mean ordering matches average rubric-score ordering; the added information is uncertainty.
每道题对应一个未知的分类概率向量。Dirichlet 先验与观测到的类别计数结合，得到后验分布。评分权重决定所估计的量，即各题期望加权得分的平均值。Bayes@N 给出这个量的后验均值和标准差。采用均匀先验且各题试验次数相同时，后验均值排序与平均评分排序一致，额外提供的是不确定性。

title: Method
方法
html: Store outcomes in a question-by-trial integer matrix and define the category weights before comparing models. Tally each row's categories, add the prior counts, and apply the closed-form posterior moments in Algorithm 1. Prior observations can be supplied when their reuse is justified. In the categorical experiments, correctness, formatting, length and log-probability signals define rubric categories; some schemas also use calibrated CompassVerifier-3B label probabilities. The statistical estimator depends on those category assignments rather than validating answers itself.
把结果存成题目乘试验次数的整数矩阵，并在比较模型前确定类别权重。逐题统计类别次数，加入先验计数，再按算法 1 计算后验矩。如果复用依据充分，也可加入历史观测。分类实验结合正确性、格式、长度和对数概率构造评分类别，部分方案还使用经过校准的 CompassVerifier-3B 标签概率。统计估计器依赖这些分类结果，答案是否正确仍由上游检查决定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper derives posterior moments and the uniform-prior ordering equivalence. Experiments include simulations with known success rates and repeated evaluation on AIME'24/'25, HMMT'25 and BrUMO'25. Appendix G describes twenty model configurations and 80 trials per question. Ranking convergence depends on the task, trial budget and model pool, and some comparisons remain unresolved within the budget. The categorical experiments show that changing the rubric can change the comparison target and resulting rankings.
论文推导了后验矩以及均匀先验下的排序等价关系。实验包括已知成功概率的模拟，以及 AIME'24/'25、HMMT'25 和 BrUMO'25 上的重复评测。附录 G 描述了二十种模型配置和每题八十次试验。排序收敛取决于任务、试验预算和模型集合，部分比较在该预算内仍无法确定。分类实验还表明，改变评分规则会改变比较目标和排序结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution combines categorical evaluation, weighted rubrics and analytic performance uncertainty in one posterior calculation. It separates the estimated score from the evidence supporting a model comparison. Its relationship to average accuracy is explicit: a uniform prior preserves ordering at matched trial counts. This card covers that ICLR evaluation method. The existing ACL 2026 ranking card studies ranking methods under test-time scaling; both papers share the Scorio implementation.
这项工作把分类评测、加权评分和解析性能不确定性放进同一次后验计算，并区分估计得分与支持模型比较的证据。它明确说明了与平均准确率的关系：在试验次数一致时，均匀先验保持原有排序。本卡介绍 ICLR 的评测方法；仓库已有的 ACL 2026 卡片研究推理时扩展下的排序方法。两篇论文共用 Scorio 实现。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The model assumes independent trials within each question and independent question posteriors. Its uncertainty is conditional on the benchmark, rubric, prior and inference settings. It does not repair dataset bias, contamination, distribution shift or verifier errors. Informative priors need a separate reuse justification. Mean and variance are analytic, while a Gaussian interval approximation requires its own conditions. Mathematical reasoning experiments do not establish results for every application domain.
模型假设每题内部的试验独立，各题后验也相互独立。不确定性以选定的基准、评分规则、先验和推理设置为条件，不会修复数据偏差、污染、分布变化或验证器错误。使用信息先验需要另行说明复用依据。均值和方差可以解析计算，采用高斯近似区间则需要满足相应条件。数学推理实验也不能证明所有应用领域的表现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An evaluator can reuse the outcome-matrix representation to report performance alongside sampling uncertainty when comparing post-training checkpoints or sampling budgets. For graded evaluation, record the category definitions and weights so readers can reconstruct the target quantity. Keep verifier provenance and trial settings with the results. Use the Scorio APIs for implementation, while treating this card as a paper reference rather than a second software entry. No training-data construction or RL improvement is established by this estimator.
比较后训练检查点或采样预算时，可以沿用结果矩阵，同时报告性能和采样不确定性。分级评测还应记录类别定义与权重，使读者能够重建所比较的量。结果需要附带验证器来源和试验设置。实现可使用 Scorio 的接口，本卡只补充论文记录，不再新增软件条目。估计器本身没有建立训练数据构造或强化学习改进的结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Start with sections 2.2 through 2.6 for the input matrix, weighted target, posterior moments and ordering equivalence. Read section 3 with Appendix G for the benchmark and sampling protocol, then Appendix D for rubric construction and verifier dependence. Section 5 states what finite-sample uncertainty does not cover. Separate comparisons to simulated true probabilities from comparisons to a finite high-trial reference. Paper-specific dataset links and benchmark reuse terms remain gaps in this card.
先读第 2.2 至 2.6 节，理解输入矩阵、加权目标、后验矩和排序等价关系。第 3 节应与附录 G 的基准及采样设置一起阅读，附录 D 则说明评分规则的构造及其对验证器的依赖。第 5 节列出了有限样本不确定性没有覆盖的问题。注意区分模拟中的真实概率参照与实验中有限次高预算参照。本卡尚未核实论文专属数据链接和基准复用条款。

A recorded correctness or rubric category per response; posterior performance is computed from category counts.
